|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E7 (version 8 of 9) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[A Brave Resistance (Errata 8)]] (PC-E8). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V9-L-A_Brave_Resistance-2023-10.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V9-L-A_Brave_Resistance-2023-10-02-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V9-L-A_Brave_Resistance-PC-E2-errata-2023-10.png]], 30 September 2023) → [[File:V9-L-A_Brave_Resistance-2023-10-02-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V9-L-A_Brave_Resistance-2023-10.png]], 2 October 2023). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E2”, but this is errata 7 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[A Brave Resistance]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-abraveresistance022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/abraveresistance.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/abraveresistance.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Surprise Assault”. Text: “If your [Episode VII] location on table, deploy on table. Your Force generation is +1 at Jakku battlegrounds you occupy. During your deploy phase, may place a Resistance character from hand on top of Used Pile to take a Resistance character into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Brave Resistance (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 July 2020<ref name="img-abraveresistancefdfe14b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/abraveresistance.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/fdfe14b7f81967a10e659a872abdeebecd8c5a25 commit fdfe14b] (12 July 2020); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/abraveresistance.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “Resistance character into hand” → “Resistance character of equal or lesser ability into hand”; the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Surprise Assault”. Text: “If your [Episode VII] location on table, deploy on table. Your Force generation is +1 at Jakku battlegrounds you occupy. During your deploy phase, may place a Resistance character from hand on top of Used Pile to take a Resistance character of equal or lesser ability into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”
